ebook-negotiate-close.title: 1. Negotiation starts before price
ebook-negotiate-close.body: Power comes from alternatives, clear value, and willingness to walk. Desperation is visible.

ebook-negotiate-close.title: 2. Anchoring with packages
ebook-negotiate-close.body: Present tiers. Let them choose down, not invent a number from zero.

ebook-negotiate-close.title: 3. Trading, not folding
ebook-negotiate-close.body: If they want a lower price, remove scope or extend timeline. Never give the same scope for less without a trade.

ebook-negotiate-close.title: 4. Handling the I will think about it moment
ebook-negotiate-close.body: Ask what specifically is unclear: fit, timing, money, trust. Solve the real objection.

ebook-negotiate-close.title: 5. Written summary closes
ebook-negotiate-close.body: After verbal yes, send scope, price, timeline, payment in chat. Ask for confirmation reply.

ebook-negotiate-close.title: 6. Deposits and boundaries
ebook-negotiate-close.body: Work starts when deposit lands. Exceptions become your new policy whether you like it or not.

ebook-negotiate-close.title: 7. Enterprise-ish buyers
ebook-negotiate-close.body: Multiple stakeholders mean slower closes. Find the economic buyer and the daily user.

ebook-negotiate-close.title: 8. Practice scripts
ebook-negotiate-close.body: Rehearse price delivery out loud. Smooth delivery increases perceived value.

ebook-digital-marketing.title: 1. Marketing that pays rent
ebook-digital-marketing.body:
Digital marketing for SMEs is not posting daily for likes. It is creating attention that becomes conversations and conversations that become paid work. Start from revenue goals, not content calendars.

Pick one offer, one audience, two channels. Measure chats and sales weekly. Everything else is decoration until those numbers move.

ebook-digital-marketing.title: 2. Offer and landing clarity
ebook-digital-marketing.body:
Your profile, site, and pinned post must answer: what, for whom, proof, next step. Confusion is the silent killer of ads and organic reach.

Use a single primary CTA: WhatsApp with a prefilled message or a booking link. Secondary links dilute action.

ebook-digital-marketing.title: 3. Content that sells without screaming
ebook-digital-marketing.body:
Rotate: proof (results), process (how you work), product (what you sell), person (trust). Educational posts earn attention; commercial posts harvest it.

Batch create weekly. Repurpose one idea into status, short video caption, and a carousel.

ebook-digital-marketing.title: 4. WhatsApp and social as a system
ebook-digital-marketing.body: Social sends people into WhatsApp. WhatsApp converts. Track which post or status produced the chat. Without tracking you scale noise.

ebook-digital-marketing.title: 5. Paid amplification
ebook-digital-marketing.body: Boost only content that already performs. Start small, kill losers fast, scale winners carefully. Watch cost per conversation.

ebook-digital-marketing.title: 6. Email and remarketing light
ebook-digital-marketing.body: If you collect emails or broadcast lists, send useful weekly notes — not only promos. Consistency beats cleverness.

ebook-digital-marketing.title: 7. Brand basics
ebook-digital-marketing.body: Same name, colours, tone across channels. Inconsistent brands feel risky to pay.

ebook-digital-marketing.title: 8. 90-day plan
ebook-digital-marketing.body: Days 1–30: clarity and organic rhythm. 31–60: improve conversion in chat. 61–90: selective paid. Review monthly with revenue, not vanity metrics.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 1. Affiliate as a real business model
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body: You earn commission promoting products you did not build. Trust is the product. Promote junk once and your audience leaves forever.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 2. Niche and audience fit
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body: Pick problems you understand. Finance tools, learning platforms, software for freelancers, health-adjacent products with compliance care — match your credibility.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 3. Traffic that converts
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body: Content sites, YouTube, newsletters, communities, and short video can work. Own an email list when possible so algorithm changes do not erase you.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 4. Honest promotion framework
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body: Disclose affiliate relationships. Share who it is for and who should skip. Compare alternatives. Long-term income beats one shady spike.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 5. Tracking and optimisation
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body: Use program dashboards. Note which content drives sales. Double down; cut the rest.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 6. Compliance and reputation
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body: No fake scarcity, no guaranteed income claims, no medical miracles. Platforms and regulators notice.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 7. Diversify offers carefully
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body: Two to five strong offers beat twenty random links. Depth of content wins.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 8. 30-day launch
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body: Week 1 choose niche and program. Week 2 publish three useful assets. Week 3 promote and engage. Week 4 review conversions and improve the best asset.

ebook-smm.title: 1. Social media management is operations
ebook-smm.body: Clients pay for consistency, clarity, and growth toward business goals — not random aesthetics.

ebook-smm.title: 2. Onboarding a client
ebook-smm.body: Brand kit, goals, offer, forbidden topics, approval process, posting schedule, reporting day. Ambiguity creates conflict.

ebook-smm.title: 3. Content systems
ebook-smm.body: Pillars, batching, caption templates, stock of proof content. Build a library so busy weeks still ship.

ebook-smm.title: 4. Community and inbox
ebook-smm.body: Reply speed matters. Assign who handles comments and DMs. Escalation path for complaints.

ebook-smm.title: 5. Reporting without theatre
ebook-smm.body: Show reach, engagement, clicks/chats, and business outcomes when available. Explain changes in plain language.

ebook-smm.title: 6. Pricing your SMM service
ebook-smm.body: Price for hours plus complexity of channels. Packages with clear deliverable counts prevent scope creep.

ebook-smm.title: 7. Tools stack light
ebook-smm.body: Scheduler, drive for assets, shared calendar, simple analytics. Avoid tool bloat.

ebook-smm.title: 8. Retaining clients
ebook-smm.body: Proactive ideas monthly, honest when something underperforms, and documented wins. Retention is profit.

ebook-virtual-assistant.title: 1. Positioning as a VA
ebook-virtual-assistant.body: General VA or specialist (podcast, ecommerce, real estate, founder ops). Specialists charge more and market easier.

ebook-virtual-assistant.title: 2. Core skill stack
ebook-virtual-assistant.body: Communication, calendar, email triage, document prep, research, basic spreadsheets, confidentiality.

ebook-virtual-assistant.title: 3. Finding clients
ebook-virtual-assistant.body: Network, job boards carefully, partnerships with agencies, content that shows how you save founder time.

ebook-virtual-assistant.title: 4. Packages and retainers
ebook-virtual-assistant.body: Hour bundles or outcome packages. Retainers stabilise income. Define response times.

ebook-virtual-assistant.title: 5. Tools and security
ebook-virtual-assistant.body: Password practices, shared drives permissions, 2FA, never mix client data casually across accounts.

ebook-virtual-assistant.title: 6. Daily workflow
ebook-virtual-assistant.body: Priority list from client, deep work blocks, end-of-day summary. Visibility builds trust.

ebook-virtual-assistant.title: 7. Boundaries
ebook-virtual-assistant.body: Scope documents protect relationships. Extra work equals change requests or new quotes.

ebook-virtual-assistant.title: 8. Growth path
ebook-virtual-assistant.body: From solo VA to processes you can template — and eventually productised services or a small team.

ebook-ig-tiktok-local.title: 1. Local services win with proof nearby
ebook-ig-tiktok-local.body: People buy from people who look like they serve their city. Show real locations, real jobs, real faces when appropriate.

ebook-ig-tiktok-local.title: 2. Short video angles
ebook-ig-tiktok-local.body: Before/after, day-in-the-life, myth vs fact, price transparency, customer reactions (with permission).

ebook-ig-tiktok-local.title: 3. Hooks in three seconds
ebook-ig-tiktok-local.body: Start with the problem or result, not a logo animation. Text on screen for silent autoplay.

ebook-ig-tiktok-local.title: 4. Posting cadence
ebook-ig-tiktok-local.body: Sustainable beats burnout. Three strong pieces weekly can outperform daily mediocrity.

ebook-ig-tiktok-local.title: 5. Turn views into WhatsApp chats
ebook-ig-tiktok-local.body: Link in bio, story stickers, pinned comment with clear CTA. Track which video produces chats.

ebook-ig-tiktok-local.title: 6. Hashtags and discovery
ebook-ig-tiktok-local.body: Mix local tags with niche tags. Avoid spam tag lists. Location stickers help locally.

ebook-ig-tiktok-local.title: 7. Collaboration
ebook-ig-tiktok-local.body: Cross-promote with complementary local businesses. Shared audiences compound.

ebook-ig-tiktok-local.title: 8. Monthly content board
ebook-ig-tiktok-local.body: Plan themes around seasons, payday weeks, and local events. Prepare assets in advance.

ebook-price-web-ng.title: 1. Price is positioning
ebook-price-web-ng.body: In Nigeria's freelance web market, racing to the bottom attracts the worst clients. Price for scope, skill, and support.

ebook-price-web-ng.title: 2. Know your floor
ebook-price-web-ng.body: Calculate monthly costs and target hours. Never quote below survival for complex work.

ebook-price-web-ng.title: 3. Package website offers
ebook-price-web-ng.body: One-pager, business site, ecommerce-lite — with clear page counts and revision limits.

ebook-price-web-ng.title: 4. Handling budget objections
ebook-price-web-ng.body: Reduce scope, extend timeline, or offer phased delivery. Do not silently accept misery rates.

ebook-price-web-ng.title: 5. Contracts and deposits
ebook-price-web-ng.body: Written scope, 40–60% deposit, milestone payments, who owns accounts and code.

ebook-price-web-ng.title: 6. Value-based moments
ebook-price-web-ng.body: When the site clearly drives bookings or sales, price reflects outcome — with proof.

ebook-price-web-ng.title: 7. Raising rates
ebook-price-web-ng.body: Announce for new clients first. Grandfather old clients briefly, then migrate.

ebook-price-web-ng.title: 8. Portfolio pricing signals
ebook-price-web-ng.body: Show project types and starting prices publicly to filter unserious inquiries.

ebook-gbp.title: 1. Why Google Business Profile matters
ebook-gbp.body: Local searches still send high-intent customers. A complete profile beats a pretty Instagram with no map presence.

ebook-gbp.title: 2. Claim and verify correctly
ebook-gbp.body: Accurate name, category, service area, hours, phone, WhatsApp if offered. Consistency across the web reduces confusion.

ebook-gbp.title: 3. Photos and posts
ebook-gbp.body: Real photos of premises and work. Weekly posts with offers or updates keep the profile alive.

ebook-gbp.title: 4. Reviews system
ebook-gbp.body: Ask happy customers with a direct link. Reply to all reviews professionally. Never buy fake reviews.

ebook-gbp.title: 5. Q&A and messaging
ebook-gbp.body: Seed common questions. Respond to messages quickly — speed is a ranking and conversion factor.

ebook-gbp.title: 6. Services and products
ebook-gbp.body: List services with price ranges when possible. Clarity filters tire-kickers.

ebook-gbp.title: 7. Avoid suspensions
ebook-gbp.body: Follow Google rules on name packing and categories. Sudden spammy changes look manipulative.

ebook-gbp.title: 8. Monthly GBP checklist
ebook-gbp.body: Hours correct, photos fresh, reviews replied, posts updated, spam listings reported.
